'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good Day, brother! I've got a job for you. Have you seen how many cash registers at Ultra are locked up? You can't just break into them. I've got a feeling there's still something valuable left inside. If you can help me get the keys, I'll give you access to some better gear. And of course, I'll share the loot.

Look for the keys somewhere near the cash registers, they might've been left behind there. My guys are too busy right now to dig around themselves. Leave those keys somewhere nearby, please.}}

== Requirements== 
* Must have [[Ragman]] LL2 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
*Stash the [[Goshan cash register key]] at the BIZARRO store fitting rooms on Interchange.
*Stash the [[IDEA cash register key]] at Register #9 on Interchange.
*Stash the [[OLI cash register key]] at Register #7-8 on Interchange.

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
*[[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 167,000 Roubles
** 173,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 183,700 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Phase control relay]]
* 1× [[MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset]]
* 1× [[Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset]]
